params.body:
## Why

The team's assistant had the source tools only, so a question about how Gentells works, or about a publisher, still became a mail. And the page of a source a person kept said "cited by Gentells" while nothing on the site cites it.

## What

- Six more tools on `/mcp`, listed to the proven team only and answered by the Observatory: `guide`, `question_note`, `question_list`, `desk_open`, `source_find`, `source_trial`. What they change is shown first and done on `confirm: true`.
- An answer to a question the person left for development comes along as `answers_to_tell`, once.
- The instructions tell the assistant to look in the guide first and to offer a written question instead of a mail.
- Every tool is on the first page of the tool list (the default page held 15).
- A source page that no post or report cites says "A source kept by Gentells".
- MCP contract 4.2.0, added only.

## Checked

- `McpSourceToolsTest`, `McpContractTest` (only additions), `CitedSourcePageTest`. Full suite 685 of 686; the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which needs a git folder the worktree does not have.
- A real assistant against a throwaway site and pipeline, described in the pipeline pull request "The team's own assistant answers what used to become a mail".

## After merge

Nothing to run. Until the pipeline change is deployed the new tools answer that this account or tool is not open.
params.title: The team's assistant gets the guide, what waits, sources and questions through /mcp
